headline: Autoscaling group desired_capacity violates min_size constraint

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf sets min_size = 3 and desired_capacity = 1. AWS requires desired_capacity to be between min_size and max_size, so this configuration is invalid. Terraform apply will either fail or force the ASG to maintain min_size (3) instances despite the desired_capacity setting.
findings.explanation: This change won't scale down to 1 instance as intended. To achieve overnight cost savings, min_size must also be reduced from 3 to 1, or the desired_capacity setting will be ignored. The ASG will stay at 3 instances (the minimum), defeating the purpose of this change.
